examples.title: Convert SmartVector output to motion channels
examples.code:
# Convert SmartVector data into motion channels.
vector_to_motion = nuke.createNode("VectorToMotion")
vector_to_motion.setInput(0, smart_vector)

provenance.editorial_note: Assumes smart_vector is an existing SmartVector node.

status_reason: Source-backed editorial example(s) added from Foundry research pass 1.
